fd2df559fb83793604ad9674f2b28a01.overview: Harry Valentini and Moe Dickstein are both errand boys for the Mob. When they lose $250,000, they are set up to kill each other. But they run off to Atlantic City and comedy follows.
fd2df559fb83793604ad9674f2b28a01.tagline: What kind of guys gamble with the boss's money, swipe a killer's Cadillac, and party on the mob's credit card?

fd36bde694f178456ff7943e49cf3d9c.overview: Ella Blake, a stop-motion animator struggling to control her demons after the loss of her overbearing mother, embarks upon the creation of a film that becomes the battleground for her sanity. As Ella’s mind starts to fracture, the characters in her project take on a life of their own.

fd8f3c118dd433d2b59c7902d7a49ef1.overview: Released on DVD as part of The Criterion Collection's "Martha Graham: Dance on Film" collection.

fdc388f41488101aec5a20cadff83332.overview: Naïve Michael Jordon is drawn into a web of government secrets when a girl carrying a mysterious package gets into a taxi with him. When she's later murdered, Michael becomes the chief suspect and goes on the run.
fdc388f41488101aec5a20cadff83332.tagline: When you're wanted for a murder you didn't commit, chased for secrets you didn't steal, and running from people who want to kill you, the worst mistake you can make is falling in love...

fdd75ad6fe8f5f498cdaee0235af3930.overview: When a major newspaper accuses wealthy socialite Connie Allenbury of being a home-wrecker, and she files a multi-million-dollar libel lawsuit, the publication's frazzled head editor, Warren Haggerty, must find a way to turn the tables on her. Soon Haggerty's harried fiancée, Gladys Benton, and his dashing friend Bill Chandler are in on a scheme that aims to discredit Connie, with amusing and unexpected results.
fdd75ad6fe8f5f498cdaee0235af3930.tagline: At the top of their game.

fdd7ad9a30cb604848edc7a0c91cdfba.overview: After being released from a mental hospital, a troubled young man tracks down an actress he once had sex with and forces her into captivity, determined to make her part of his life.
fdd7ad9a30cb604848edc7a0c91cdfba.tagline: A love story... with strings attached!

fdea8b30d3907c0ef37b8532e85bc6be.overview: The rise of a raucous hayseed named Lonesome Rhodes from itinerant Ozark guitar picker to local media rabble-rouser to TV superstar and political king-maker. Marcia Jeffries is the innocent Sarah Lawrence girl who discovers the great man in a back-country jail and is the first to fall under his spell.
fdea8b30d3907c0ef37b8532e85bc6be.tagline: POWER! He loved it! He took it raw in big gulpfuls … he liked the taste, the way it mixed with the bourbon and the sin in his blood!

fdf9e8f2b0d38a35297093bad11c6fca.overview: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.
